Based on my testing, here are the final qlang queries:

L1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (/items | * (mul /qty (at :price | coalesce 0)) | sum) | sum | round 2

L2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :labels | ne null) | filter ~(at :labels | count | gt 0) | * /labels | flat | groupBy * count

L3: [(/dependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^0") | keys) (/devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^0") | keys)] | flat | distinct | sort | * (keyword)

L4: /data/users | filter ~(at :active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (at :email | lower) | distinct | sort

L5: /services | filter ~(if (at :enabled | coalesce true) ~(at :port | ne null) ~(false)) | keys | * (: k / | {:name /k :port (/services | at /k | at :port)}) | sort ~/port

L6: split "\n" | filter ~(split " " | :p / | if (at 1 | eq "GET") ~(p | at 3 | eq "200") ~(false)) | * (split " " | at 4 | split "ms" | at 0 | parseJson) | :nums / | (nums | sum) | div (nums | count) | round 1

L7: split "\n" | drop 1 | filter ~(split "," | count | eq 4) | filter ~(split "," | at 2 | ne "") | * (split "," | :row / | {:dept (row | at 1 | lower) :salary (row | at 2 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | :salaries / | (salaries | sum) | div (salaries | count) | round 0)

L8: groupBy ~/user | * count | keys | * (/ | keyword | append ":" | append (apply ~(groupBy ~/user | * count | at /) /))

L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," | * ((split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join " ") | lower) | distinct | sort | join "|"

L10: split "\n" | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(split " " | at 0 | ne "#") | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | [(at 0 | lower) (at 1)])

L11: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | eq null) | sort ~/number | sort ~/comments | reverse | take 2 | * /number

L12: groupBy ~/customer | filter ~(/ | count | gte 2) | keys | * (keyword)

L13: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | * (* /name | sort)

L14: filter ~(/type | eq "push") | filter ~(at :payload | coalesce {} | at :repo | coalesce {} | at :name | ne null) | * (at :payload | at :repo | at :name) | distinct | sort
